Find local disaster recovery contacts (aging services, crisis counseling, housing, legal aid, ...) for a specific state or territory such as `american-samoa`, `commonwealth-northern-mariana-islands` or `virgin-islands`.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->

category_contains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on the Category cell, e.g. `Housing`, `Crisis`, `Legal`. Without it every row is returned.

slug.description: Directory page slug from `list_referral_directories`, e.g. `american-samoa`, `commonwealth-northern-mariana-islands`, `virgin-islands`, `guam`, `puerto-rico`, `texas`. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$.

200.description:
One state or territory local-level referral directory (/assistance/individual/disaster-survivors/state-local-referral-lists/{slug}): every row of the page's referral table with service category, entity, the entity's link when the page has one, the type of assistance, the telephone cell as written and the phone numbers parsed from it, plus the page's last-updated timestamp and Drupal node id. Rows are returned in page order; a cell the page leaves blank is null.

The response contains the tool result directly.
